proposition: The two Niʿmatullahi accounts do not agree in detail: Kirmānī says the two went to Syria at Niʿmat Allāh's direction to become Akhlāṭī's disciples and omits the companions and the sealed box; the Savāniḥ has Niʿmat Allāh, Qāsim-i Anvār, Ibn Turka, Yazdī and Pīr Tāj Gīl arriving together at Akhlāṭī's Nile house.
